title: Fast EA-recovery beyond quadratic vectorial functions
summary: Find a general EA-equivalence recovery algorithm for degree-greater-than-two vectorial functions that improves asymptotically on generic code-equivalence recovery.

formal_statement.body: For arbitrary dimensions $n,m$ and vectorial Boolean functions $F,G:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^m$ of algebraic degree greater than two, give an algorithm that, whenever they exist, recovers affine permutations $A,B$ and an affine function $C$ satisfying $$G=A\circ F\circ B+C.$$ Prove correctness for every admissible pair and an asymptotic complexity strictly below applying the generic code-equivalence recovery method to the associated codes.

scope.domain: Extended-affine equivalence recovery for vectorial Boolean functions
assumptions: $F$ and $G$ have algebraic degree strictly greater than two
The algorithm applies in arbitrary input and output dimensions
Recovery returns the affine maps when an EA equivalence exists
The comparison baseline is the source's generic code-equivalence method
scope.unresolved_remainder: The later ePrint gives faster recovery for uniformly distributed $k$-to-one functions with a specific preimage structure and extensions to selected EA cases. It does not cover arbitrary degree-greater-than-two vectorial functions or prove the required general asymptotic improvement.

progress.summary: The source asks for a general EA-recovery algorithm beyond quadratic functions that beats generic code-equivalence recovery in every dimension.
A later ePrint gives substantially faster equivalence recovery for structured uniformly distributed $k$-to-one functions and selected EA extensions, a strict subclass of the requested domain.
